title: Regional fallback retrospective traces and decision playback
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: When a request is routed across regions or tier fallbacks (eg. hosted -> dedicated -> low-cost variant), teams lack a cohesive, replayable trace that shows the decision points, policy inputs, and the model-variant used at each hop. Current telemetry emits per-hop metrics but lacks a compact, queryable retrospective trace and a lightweight payload snapshot that can be attached to incident timelines and SLO investigations.

Goal: Implement a "retrospective trace" artifact that captures the routing decision graph for a request (region selection, tier routing, fallback variant chosen), with enough context to reproduce routing logic offline, but compact enough to store at 7-14 day retention by default. Provide playback hooks in the Console for engineers to step through each decision node and see per-hop metrics (latency, token-cost estimate, request attributes) and attached sampled payload snapshots.

Success criteria / Acceptance criteria:
- New retrospective trace object saved for 1% sample of cross-region/fallback requests in Prod, configurable per-customer.
- Trace contains a normalized decision graph with nodes: initial policy input, region_score vector, tier_evaluation, model_variant_resolution, and final target. All nodes must reference concise reason codes and cost/latency estimates.
- Console can render a selected trace as an interactive timeline with per-hop metrics and links to sampled artifacts (prompt hash, model version, small token prefix).
- Playback tool allows simulation of the routing logic against historical policy snapshots (policy version id) without executing model inference.
- Storage overhead per trace <= 2KB on average (after compression), and prototype shows <5% added write latency on the request path (sampling path).

Out-of-scope for this ticket: full-fidelity request body capture, automatic user-visible incident creation, and cross-customer lineage queries. Those are future work items.
telemetry_schema: Fields captured: request_id, timestamp, policy_version, input_attributes (subset), region_scores, tier_scores, decision_reasons[], selected_model_variant, hop_metrics:{latency_ms, token_estimate, error_flag}, sampled_artifact_refs (s3:// or blob id). All values normalized to string types in storage layer. Schema draft: /confluence/smart-routing/retrospective-trace-schema
sampling_strategy: Default: 1% random sampling for requests that triggered a region switch or fallback variant in the past 24h. Configurable via tenant flag (console + API). For high-severity customers we support 100% sampling toggle behind feature flag.
implementation_notes:
Backend changes: (1) Add trace builder in routing service (ruby -> golang shim) that records decision nodes after the final routing verdict. (2) Compress and emit to telemetry pipeline as a new retrospective_trace protobuf. (3) Storage: route to low-cost blobstore partition with index in clickhouse for quick lookups by request_id. (4) Console: new trace viewer component that fetches the decision graph + artifacts.

Performance: must keep synchronous path overhead <5% when sampling enabled. Use async flush to pipeline and optimize protobuf + zstd. Instrument metrics: trace_build_time_ms, trace_emit_errors, trace_size_bytes_avg.

Data controls: sampled_artifact_refs must omit plaintext user data; only store token-prefix (first 64 chars) hashed + base64 compressed. KMS tags added for tenant separation.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): 10% of requests in staging + 0.5% in prod across two regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1) for 2 weeks. Phase 2 (ramped): 1% global sample + tenant opt-in. Phase 3: console enablement and tenant-level controls. Feature flag: routing.retrospective_traces (boolean) + routing.trace_sample_rate (float).
console_changes: Add 'Retrospective Trace' tab to Routing -> Request inspector. UI shows interactive graph, per-hop expanders with metrics, and 'Replay Decision' button that simulates policy execution. Link to sampled artifact blob with quick diff view. Design mock: /drive/designs/routing-trace-view-v1.png
qa_plan:
Unit tests for protobuf serialization + compression. Integration test: end-to-end trace flow in staging with synthetic traffic that triggers fallback. Load test: validate async pipeline at 10k traces/min without backpressure. Manual QA: validate Console rendering for long graphs (>10 hops) and verify privacy filters.

Acceptance tests: (1) Create synthetic policy that forces a fallback chain across three tiers and verify trace nodes and reason codes. (2) Validate storage size per trace under target.
timeline: Week 1: wire trace builder and schema, add protobuf + pipeline topic. Week 2: storage + index, console API. Week 3: console viewer + canary. Week 4: ramp and docs.
blocked_by: Clarify retention policy and tenant opt-in defaults with privacy team. Need KMS tagging design from Security. Also awaiting clickhouse schema signoff from Infra.
notes_and_comments: 2025-02-10 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem from 2025-02-08 cross-region SLO breach where root cause was misrouted traffic due to stale policy. Goal is to create a replayable artifact for RCA.
2025-02-12 Arjun Patel: Prototype of trace protobuf implemented. Initial size (uncompressed) ~4.8KB; zstd reduces to ~1.6KB. Need to trim some decision attributes to meet 2KB target.
2025-02-14 Sophia Ruiz (Telemetry): Suggest storing full policy_version and abbreviated rule_ids instead of full rule text to save space. Will add decoder in Console to fetch rule text on-demand.
2025-02-16 Security (E. Morales): Reviewed privacy constraints. Confirmed we can store 64-char token prefix hashed; full request payload must remain sequestered. Need KMS tag for tenant blobs.
2025-02-18 Arjun Patel: Canaries deployed to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 (0.5% sample). Observed trace_build_time_ms p95 = 4.2ms, trace_emit_errors = 0.
